description: This Java class implements a cache for album artwork images, supporting asynchronous loading and retrieval, with size management and cache eviction.

classes.name: AlbumArtCache
classes.description: A singleton class that manages an in-memory cache of album art bitmaps, supporting asynchronous fetch and resize operations.

classes.name: AlbumArtCache.FetchListener
classes.description: An abstract callback class for handling the completion or failure of album art fetch operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of AlbumArtCache.

methods.name: AlbumArtCache
methods.description: Private constructor initializing the cache with size limits based on available memory.

methods.name: getBigImage
methods.description: Retrieves the large album art bitmap for a given URL from cache.

methods.name: getIconImage
methods.description: Retrieves the icon-sized album art bitmap for a given URL from cache.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Fetches album art asynchronously; if in cache, returns immediately; otherwise, downloads and caches it.
